description: Profitability margins and balance-sheet ratios for every period: every margin and rate the record itself stores (gross margin %, operating margin %, effective tax rate, segment margins, efficiency ratio and the like), plus gross, operating, net and free-cash-flow margin, working capital and current ratio calculated here from the period's own figures, each labeled as calculated with its formula and the exact fields used, so it can be checked. A ratio is calculated only when both figures are in the same period of the same record; nothing is estimated. Every period in the latest record by default, or the periods named by `period`.

period.description: Fiscal period: 'FY2025', 'Q2 FY2027' (also 'FY27Q2', 'Q2 2027'), 'latest', 'latest quarter', 'latest annual', 'ttm', 'ytd', 'annual', 'quarterly', 'all', or a period-end date. The company's own fiscal years. Omit for every period in the latest record. A period earlier than the data held returns that the data does not go back that far, and what is held.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_margins_and_ratios
title: Margins and ratios
